import zipfile
import re
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

NS = 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main'

path = "budget.xlsx"
with zipfile.ZipFile(path) as z:
    ws = ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml'))
    # Show raw XML for total/balance rows to see formulas
    for row in ws.iter(f'{{{NS}}}row'):
        rnum = int(row.get('r'))
        if rnum in (8, 23, 25):
            cells = []
            for c in row.findall(f'{{{NS}}}c'):
                v = c.find(f'{{{NS}}}v')
                f = c.find(f'{{{NS}}}f')
                cells.append((c.get('r'), c.get('t'), f.text if f is not None else None, v.text if v is not None else None))
            print(f"R{rnum}: {cells}")

    # Extract all expense amounts (rows 11-22, third column) and income (rows 4-7)
    values = {}
    for row in ws.iter(f'{{{NS}}}row'):
        rnum = int(row.get('r'))
        for c in row.findall(f'{{{NS}}}c'):
            v = c.find(f'{{{NS}}}v')
            if v is not None:
                values[c.get('r')] = float(v.text)

    expense_rows = [f'C{r}' for r in range(11, 23)]
    income_rows = [f'B{r}' for r in range(4, 8)]

    expense_vals = [values[r] for r in expense_rows if r in values]
    income_vals = [values[r] for r in income_rows if r in values]

    print("\nIncome items:", [(r, values.get(r)) for r in income_rows])
    print("Income sum:", sum(income_vals))
    print("\nExpense items:", [(r, values.get(r)) for r in expense_rows])
    print("Expense sum:", sum(expense_vals))
    print("\nCount of expense entries:", len(expense_vals))

    expense_rows = [f'C{r}' for r in range(11, 23)]

    print("\nExpense items:")
    for r, val in expense_vals:
        print(f"  {r}: {val}")
    total = sum(v for _, v in expense_vals if v is not None)
    print("\nExpense sum:", total)
